01 — About us

A long room,
a short menu.

BARA opened in 2019 in a corner unit on Jalan Besar with one grinder and a second-hand oven. The room was empty concrete, so we built it from pale oak and left the ceiling alone. We buy green beans from four farms, roast them in the back, and write the menu on the wall because printing new cards felt wasteful.

Two long tables, a wall of glass, and a tree that has outgrown its pot. The same faces take the same chairs most mornings. That is the whole business plan.

03 — Our story

From green bean
to your cup.

Sixteen seconds in the room before it fills: the light moving across the floor, the counter, the shot. Shot and cut on a Tuesday morning, before the first regular arrived.
